out_of_scope.instructions: Before testing or reporting a vulnerability, confirm that the target asset is owned or managed by Dropbox. Terms like “Dropbox-compatible” do not mean Dropbox controls the system. If you're unsure, contact the program team to avoid interacting with assets outside of scope at bugbounty@dropbox.com.
